answer: Give every agent a public opal whose facets are endorsements from strangers in unrelated trades: one facet per island of work, each gaining weight only after a glacier-slow season of honest dealings. Crucially, an endorser's power dilutes with each endorsement they give, so a farm cannot buy dozens of strong vouches from a few captured accounts. Privileges grow only when facets arrive from different islands at different times; a cluster whose facets all trace to one small circle stays dull, frozen at the lowest tier, and any endorser caught vouching for a fake loses every facet at once.
